description: This file provides a doubly linked list implementation with macros and inline functions for list manipulation, including list addition, deletion, replacement, splicing, and iteration, as well as hash list structures.

methods.name: INIT_LIST_HEAD
methods.description: Macro to initialize a list head with itself as next and prev pointers.

methods.name: list_add
methods.description: Add a new entry after the specified head, useful for stack implementation.

methods.name: list_add_tail
methods.description: Add a new entry before the specified head, useful for queue implementation.

methods.name: list_del
methods.description: Remove an entry from the list, leaving it in an undefined state.

methods.name: list_replace
methods.description: Replace an old list entry with a new one.

methods.name: list_del_init
methods.description: Delete an entry and reinitialize it.

methods.name: list_move
methods.description: Move an entry to the head of another list.

methods.name: list_move_tail
methods.description: Move an entry to the tail of another list.

methods.name: list_is_last
methods.description: Check if a list entry is the last in the list.

methods.name: list_empty
methods.description: Check if a list is empty.

methods.name: list_splice_init
methods.description: Join two lists and reinitialize the source list.
